[h1]Information from the Developer[/h1]
First off, I would like to thank everyone for joining me on this incredible journey so far. I've been at it for at least 5 years now as a solo developer and released many games in the Roxy Raccoon franchise. However, this entry in particular has always been my pride and joy and I thank everyone for supporting it just as much as I have.

A lot has happened within the last 1-2 years, I've faced many health scares and changes in my lifestyle and I can no longer develop games the way I used to (Don't worry, I'm not going to die). I will however, still support all my old games in terms of bug fixes. Don't expect new content from any of my games, but also don't fully rule out the possibility. notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Holidays![/h1]

[h2]I am just wanting to wish everyone a Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays![/h2]

Thank you for supporting the game up until this point, I cannot believe that it has come this far! Sorry to disappoint, but there will be no New Years Themed DLC, but you can be sure to expect something else in January! I am incredibly grateful to all of you and that people are still playing and interested. I will continue to support this game as long as you do as this has become my absolute favorite passion project.

 

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new prop to the main menu that is only presented after the target score is beaten on the Mancala Madness Table.
[*] Added new toy effects to the torches on Nasty Knights & Creepy Castle that have been tied to various Missions/Witch Trials.
[*] Removed unnecessary post-game stats on certain arcade games.
[*] Added missing images to the table creator and customization screens.
[*] Increased text reveal speed during cutscenes.
[*] Added an option in Gameplay Settings to certain lighting effects. This is an accessibility option for those who have difficulties with flashing lights.
[/list]

[list]
[*] A new minigame added to Rapid Ryan's Arcade

[/list]

I have been working behind the scenes in the next game in the Roxy Raccoon Franchise named Witchy Woes! I will be showcasing it in the February next fest. It is a top down shooter/dungeon crawler with a bit of a Hotline Miami influence. If that sounds even remotely interesting to you, please check it out in the link below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2346360/Witchy_Woes/

[h1]Table Editor[/h1]
[h2]Mission/Trial LEDs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Missions/Trials can now have LEDs associated to each mechanic.
[*] This allows for better visual representation of trial progress as well as the creation of more advanced trials.
[*] Assign LED button will only appear after mechanics have been attached to the mission.
[*] Pre-game LED animations will play before the game is started. These are automatically generated. However, there is a setting to adjust the number of times each object flashes before moving onto the next trial. You can also adjust the speed/rate at which the flashes occur.
[/list]
[h3]Targets (Stationary, Drop, Bunnies, Pirate Ship Steering Wheels, etc…) &Rollovers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Repeatable: The number of times these objects need to be interacted with to complete the part of the trial. All objects can be interacted with numerous times.
[*] No-Order: Each object needs to be interacted with at least once before moving onto the next part of the trial. All LEDs will be turned on at the start but will turn off to indicate which objects have been interacted with.
[*] Ordered: Each object needs to be interacted with at least once before moving onto the next part of the trial. LEDs will turn on one at a time, in the order that they were assigned. You must interact with each object before moving onto the next.
[/list]
 
[h3]Bumpers, Spinners, Holes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Repeatable: The number of times these objects need to be interacted with to complete the part of the trial. All objects can be interacted with numerous times.
[/list]

[h1]Table Creator:[/h1]
[h2]Mission/Trial Creator![/h2]
[h3]Create, Edit & Delete Missions/Trials[/h3] 
This was a long time in the making and I have also tried to write a comprehensive guide/documentation and a video on how it all works which I will provide links to at the bottom. I have put this off due to finding a lot of bugs along the way, but I believe it is now bug free and working as intended. If you are experiencing issues or encounter anything abnormal, please let me know and I will investigate. It is a very complex system and while I have done my best to make sure everything is in 100% perfect working order; I cannot guarantee that it is.
 
[h3]Create Trial:[/h3]
DMD/LCD Text (Mission Title & Descriptions), DMD/LCD Animations, Mission Completion Sounds, Mission Mechanics, Number of times to interact with mechanics to complete a mission, Number of mission parts (1 or 2), Mission Rewards (Points & Bonuses), Resetting the mission on losing a ball toggle.

[h3]Edit Trial:[/h3]
Select from a list of any of the trials which you have previously created. This will present you with a screen that is identical to the new trial screen, except now you are making modifications to a previously existing trial instead of starting from scratch.
 
[h3]Delete Trial:[/h3]
The initial screen will be identical to the edit trial screen; selecting from a list of any of the trials which you have previously created. From here, you can delete the trial from the table itself. This will allow you to free up the mechanics associated with that trial and re-assign them to new or pre-existing trials.
 
As expected, trials can also be saved/loaded with the tables that you create.
 
[h3]Documentation is found here:[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3001078063
 
[h3]Video to be found here:[/h3]
https://youtu.be/8a8oMbyBXFw?si=8iaKYquM7kNQhDGe
 
 
[h2]What’s next:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Attached LEDs to trial mechanics and expand on the trial editor.
[*] Various improvements/edits based on user feedback.
[*] Steam Workshop (After the above two are completed).
[/list]

notes.title: Free To Play & Upcoming Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Free To Play[/h1]
On May 10, the game will be going free to play. The base game will become free for everyone, but DLC still cost money.

[h2]Why?[/h2]
The game has evolved into something much larger than I originally planned thanks to all your support. The game was originally never going to have DLC and was meant as a one-off experience, but I am very happy with the enthusiasm some of the players have shown towards the game.

This is simply a way to reach a larger potential audience and for more people to enjoy the game.

[h2]How Does this Impact the Players?[/h2]
Simply stated, you shouldn’t notice any real impact, other than hopefully more contestants on the leaderboards.

[b]DLC will continue and pricing will NOT change. I will NOT be incorporating loot boxes, gacha mechanics, battle passes, energy systems or any of the stuff typically seen in mobile and/or other free to play games. This is simply a way to make the base game available to more players.[/b]

[h1]Upcoming Changes[/h1]
Mentioned above, I will continue to make DLC for the game and support it as always. Pricing will NOT change, and I will continue to support the game as always with a mixture of free and paid content.

I don’t plan on doing weekly updates anymore, instead focusing on larger patches. I will always employ hotfixes ASAP should the need ever arise.

There will be a patch on May 10 that introduces some improvements/fixes to old tables, and I am glad to announce that we will be going to SPACE! It is something that has been highly requested, and I am always listening to feedback and suggestions.

Spread the word, share your love for pinball and please continue to enjoy the game! 


Finally, here is a preview of the new table select screen (work in progress). This should make selecting tables much faster/simpler.
